releaseNotes:
v2.7.0 - Supplier Payment Status per Milk Collection
• Tap Paid/Unpaid status in monthly table to toggle payment for each day's milk
• Per-session (morning/evening) payment tracking for supplier milk collections
• Visual paid/unpaid indicators with color coding
• Monthly summary shows 'All Paid' or 'Has Credit' based on milk collection payments
• Database migration adds paid status to existing milk records
